$comment: Consent wording must be approved by legal, privacy and clinical governance. Versions are explicit so a policy change forces re-consent.

telehealth.title: Before your video visit
telehealth.reason: We need your agreement to a few things before your consultation starts.

items.title: Telehealth consultation
items.summary: Your video visit will use your camera and microphone, and your clinician will add notes to your medical record.
items.detail: A telehealth consultation is a real clinical appointment. Your clinician may not be able to examine you physically, and may ask you to attend in person if that is needed. This service is not for emergencies.

items.title: Sharing with your care team
items.summary: We will share your information with the clinicians involved in your care.
items.detail: This includes the clinician you see today, any specialist they refer you to, and the administrative staff who schedule your appointments. It does not include anyone outside your care.

items.title: Recording this consultation
items.summary: Allow this visit to be recorded so you can watch it back later.
items.detail: Recordings are stored securely for 90 days and are visible only to you and your clinician. You can delete a recording at any time. Declining does not affect your appointment.

items.title: Using de-identified data for research
items.summary: Allow anonymised information from your visits to help improve care.
items.detail: Your name, contact details and identifiers are removed before any data is used. You can withdraw this at any time, and doing so has no effect on your treatment.

reconsent.title: We've updated our privacy policy
reconsent.reason: Our data-sharing policy changed on 1 August 2026. Please review and confirm your choices again.
reconsent.policyChangedNote: You agreed to version 1.0 of this policy. This is version 2.0.

items.title: Sharing with your care team
items.summary: We will share your information with the clinicians involved in your care.
